rules.description: Keep changes proportional and preserve established project conventions.
Preserve task scope, user authorization, and project-owned work.
Connect completion claims to observed behavior and disclose gaps.

skills.name: ar-systematic-debugging
skills.description: Diagnose and fix reproducible failures, crashes, or regressions. Use when behavior differs from expectations; ordinary feature implementation and diff-only review have separate scopes.
